race.title: Racing Here Again On 3rd December Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: Plenty of dead wood in this maiden, MOMENT OF GRACE selected to make a winning start for Willie Mullins having gone down narrowly in a French bumper this time last year. Malte de Solzen is another French import who has joined a top yard so he could be the one to provide most resistance, with Werner and Red Seagull another couple worth considering, too. MOMENT OF GRACE (FR) MALTE DE SOLZEN (FR) WERNER (GER)
